privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.controller: The data controller is {{name}}. The site has no form and no account: you get in touch through your own email, and the messages received are only used to answer you.
privacy.logs: Like any web server, the site's server records the IP address, the requested page and the browser of each visit, for security and to keep the site running.
privacy.analytics: Visits are counted with Umami, without cookies and without storing anything that identifies you: only anonymous statistics are kept (pages viewed, country, type of device).
privacy.thirdParties: To show the site, your browser also contacts these services, which receive your IP address:
privacy.fonts: Google Fonts (Google LLC), for the fonts and icons
privacy.content: Supabase (Supabase, Inc.), for the content and the images of the projects
privacy.map: OpenStreetMap and Stadia Maps, for the map of the home page
privacy.umami: Umami Cloud (Umami Software, Inc.), for the visit statistics

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site sets no cookie. It only keeps the theme and the language you pick in your browser (local storage); these preferences never leave your device.
